facts.value: Requests one Koopa-flame article for grounded or aerial sustained Fire Breath, refreshes item/fighter bookkeeping whenever the emission-phase counter is zero, and schedules strength-dependent breath audio. The zero-counter work recurs every twelve invocations; it is not one-time initialization.

facts.rationale: Preserves all visible arguments and branches while correcting the lifetime of zero-guarded bookkeeping.
facts.value: Builds a spawn position from joint 48 plus scaled x24/x28 offsets, selects and persists a table-derived graphics value, and passes position, facing, move x4, graphics, x222C, x2230 and It_Kind_Koopa_Flame to the item spawner. It ignores the returned article pointer. At x14 == 0 it stores Item_8026AE60() in mv.kp.unk1.x4 and calls ft_80089824 and ft_800892A0. At x14 divisible by three it selects sound tiers from normalized x2230 using 0.3333f and 0.6666f, with Koopa-versus-other-kind sound branches. Finally x14 advances modulo twelve, making zero-guarded work recurrent even when article allocation fails.

facts.value: Forwards the fighter object to two shared helpers. At cur_anim_frame == 0.0f, x10 decreases by one and clamps to zero. If x18 begins at zero, Camera_RequestQuake receives QuakeKind_Small and the fighter's current position. Then x18 increments and is reduced modulo attribute x20. No zero-divisor guard or motion-state transition appears in this callback.

evidence.why: Phase progression, exact ending guards, post-transition updates and conversions.

facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported resource-exhaustion exit and states the exact continuation/ending conditions.
facts.value: Maintains paired grounded and aerial startup, sustained and ending phases. Startup animation completion enters sustained use. Sustained IASA enters ending only after the elapsed threshold is reached, B is released and x10 is zero; depletion of x222C/x2230 merely clamps them to minima and does not terminate the move. Counter and depletion updates still execute after the ending-state call. Terrain callbacks convert to the corresponding phase, and ending animation completion dispatches common grounded ending or aerial Fall.
